name: ATRA + ATO (acute promyelocytic leukemia, low-risk)

drugs.name: Tretinoin (all-trans-retinoic acid, ATRA)
drugs.notes: Harrison, 22nd ed., line 118177: 'ATRA (45 mg/m2/d) plus ATO (0.15 mg/kg/d)'. Dosed daily (continuous, /d); Harrison does not print a total induction duration or cycle count, so cycleLengthDays/cycles and a numeric days[] list are left null - verify total duration against the pending NCCN per-disease template. Rounding increment of 10 mg reflects the standard 10 mg tretinoin capsule strength, not a value printed in Harrison - verify against institutional formulary.

drugs.name: Arsenic trioxide (ATO)
drugs.notes: Harrison, 22nd ed., line 118177: 'ATRA (45 mg/m2/d) plus ATO (0.15 mg/kg/d)'. Dosed daily (continuous, /d); Harrison does not print a total induction duration or cycle count, so cycleLengthDays/cycles and a numeric days[] list are left null - verify total duration against the pending NCCN per-disease template. Rounding increment is a standard IV weight-based convention, not printed in Harrison.

supportiveCare: Antiemetics: Harrison does not print an emetogenicity tier for this regimen; per the general NCCN Antiemesis categories referenced in Appendix D, oral ATRA and IV ATO are conventionally low/minimal emetic-risk agents - use Oral Low/Minimal and IV Low tier prophylaxis per institutional antiemesis order set, escalate PRN.

G-CSF / myeloid growth factor: ATRA/ATO induction is a differentiation regimen, not a classically myelosuppressive cytotoxic backbone, so it is not assigned a High/Intermediate febrile-neutropenia tier under the Appendix C framework. Prophylactic G-CSF is not routinely indicated; manage cytopenias and infection risk per physician judgment and institutional guideline.

APL differentiation syndrome monitoring and management (fever, dyspnea, pulmonary infiltrates, effusions, hypoxemia): glucocorticoids, cytoreductive therapy, and/or temporary ATRA hold for severe cases per Harrison (lines ~118165-118176); this is the primary early toxicity, not febrile neutropenia.

monitoring: CBC with differential before and during induction
APL differentiation-syndrome surveillance (fever, dyspnea, fluid retention, pulmonary infiltrates/effusions, hypoxemia) - Harrison lines ~118165-118176
Serial PCR for PML-RARA (t(15;17)) for response/relapse monitoring, per Harrison lines ~118189-118194
ECG/QTc and serum potassium/magnesium before and during ATO therapy (standard ATO safety monitoring; not itemized at the cited Harrison lines - verify against institutional protocol/NCCN template)
No anthracycline in this low-risk ATRA/ATO combination, so routine cardiac (LVEF) surveillance is not triggered by this drug list
No platinum agent in this regimen, so routine renal-clearance monitoring for platinum dosing is not triggered by this drug list
clearanceChecks: coagulation panel (DIC risk is elevated in APL)
electrolytes (potassium, magnesium) and ECG/QTc prior to ATO

doseModificationRules.text: Review required. Protocol-specific delay/reduce criteria may apply; physician decides. Note: cytopenias are frequently disease-related in APL induction, so this generic default rule requires clinical judgment rather than automatic delay.

doseModificationRules.condition: Severe APL differentiation syndrome (e.g. renal failure or ICU-level respiratory distress)
doseModificationRules.text: Temporary discontinuation of ATRA is necessary in cases of severe APL syndrome (Harrison lines ~118172-118173); physician decides on ATO continuation and cytoreductive/glucocorticoid therapy.

core.locator: line 118177 (ATRA/ATO dosing); lines ~118165-118176 (differentiation syndrome); lines ~118189-118194 (PML-RARA response/relapse monitoring)

provenanceNote: Textbook-grounded draft (Harrison 22nd ed.); NCCN per-disease chemotherapy order template and guideline/institutional overlays not yet available. cycleLengthDays, cycles, and per-drug days[] are unresolved because ATRA/ATO induction is dosed continuously per day with no fixed day-of-cycle list or total duration printed in the cited source; represented as empty arrays (schema requires array-of-number for days) rather than an invented value, and flagged in verifyFields for follow-up against the pending NCCN template.
